ruleDefinitions.name: Download from Suspicious Dyndns Hosts
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects download of certain file types from hosts with dynamic DNS names (selected list) Note: Unmapped fields: c-uri-extension, cs-host

"docm" OR c-uri-extension = "xls" OR c-uri-extension = "xlsm" OR c-uri-extension = "pptm" OR c-uri-extension = "rtf" OR c-uri-extension = "hta" OR c-uri-extension = "dll" OR c-uri-extension = "ws" OR c-uri-extension = "wsf" OR c-uri-extension = "sct" OR c-uri-extension = "zip") AND (cs-host = RGX("\\\.hopto\\\.org$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.no\\-ip\\\.org$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.no\\-ip\\\.info$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.no\\-ip\\\.biz$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.no\\-ip\\\.com$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.noip\\\.com$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.ddns\\\.name$") OR cs-host = RGX("\\\.myftp\\\.org$") OR
